caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted object resembling the head of a horse mounted on a cylindrical base. The horse’s head is detailed, with visible ears, eyes, nostrils, mane, and jaw muscles, rendered in shades of brown. A ring is attached through the horse's mouth. The base beneath the horse head consists of cylindrical sections with decorative elements, including fluted patterns and raised bands. The entire composition is centered on a plain beige background. The artist’s signature, "Gerard Barnett," appears in small letters near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Hitching Post
